findings.observation: The recording helper pushes a method name only the first time it is called (if not started.includes(name)). Two calls to one method are therefore one entry, so swapping them is invisible: getWorkItemAgePercentiles is called at hook lines 477 and 489 with different windows and the pin cannot tell them apart.
